description.en: Saurichthys curionii has a needlelike body, long opposing jaws and rear-set dorsal and anal fins. Fossil compression leaves living body breadth, soft-tissue outlines, exact fin rays and colour uncertain.
description.zh: Saurichthys curionii 具有针状细长身体、上下相对的长颌，以及靠近尾部的背鳍和臀鳍。化石受压使活体体宽、软组织轮廓、精确鳍条及颜色仍有不确定性。

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block extremely elongate needlelike body and jaws with rear-set fins with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织极长针状身体与颌、后置鳍；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: extremely elongate needlelike body and jaws with rear-set fins. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：极长针状身体与颌、后置鳍。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Near-straight horizontal swimming posture, mild tail bend only, paired fins separated and visible; no taphonomic U-shaped body curl, no ground support in export.

scale.basis: Working artistic dimensions for a small individual; photo states slab about40cm across, not fish total length. No precise specimen measurement inferred from bent fossil.

scientific_limits.en: Fossils are compressed and curved after death; living cross-section, soft-tissue outline, exact fin rays and colors are inferred. Species identification follows the museum photograph description, without catalogue-number or specimen-exact reconstruction claim.
scientific_limits.zh: 化石压扁且死后弯曲；活体横截面、软组织轮廓、精确鳍条和颜色为推断。物种鉴定依馆藏化石照片说明，不声称馆藏号或逐标本精确复原。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original living reconstruction of Saurichthys curionii guided by the identified Lugano museum fossil from Cassina beds, Monte San Giorgio. Not a scan; original inventory genus-level research hold is addressed by named species fossil evidence plus UZH taxon research context.
shape_requirements: Retain extremely elongate needlelike body AND long pointed upper/lower jaws AND rear-set dorsal/anal fins as one original combination.
Slim tapered trunk with narrow caudal peduncle, visibly forked tail. Do not substitute deep generic fish body or eel ribbon tail.
Upper and lower jaws form a long narrow opposing pair, not merely one swordfish upper bill; readable small mouth seam and restrained teeth.
Dorsal and anal fins sit in posterior trunk near tail rather than centered; pectoral pair remain near head and pelvic pair are separate. Do not move all fins to the rear.
Use coherent profile-loft body and finite-thickness fins, no giant shark dorsal fin, no reptile limbs, no ornate unsupported armor.
